notes.title: Week 1 Update Live.
notes.content:
A huge thank you to everyone for the feedback and support, we couldn't do it without you!
Heres a brief list of the most important changes / additions.

Player has better verticle axis control of cockpit / weapons;
Disabled auto targeting.
AI now seeks player more aggressively.
New hover enemies added.
Enemy missiles are now avoidable.
Ion Cannon requires hold to charge.
Grenade Launcher uses aim arc for targeting.
Increased Shotgun damage.
Particle effects cleanup.
Added radar jamming towers.
Added new enemy type - Dropship class ( Frost and Rig Maps)
Cleaner Menus.

Added Options menu.
- Aim axis sensetivity.
- Enable PS4 controller (make sure this is disabled when using xbox / xbox one controller).
- Invert Aim Axis
- Hover Motion ( for those who are uncomfortable with floaty physics)
- Reset Seated Position.

Again all feedback is greatly appreciated so please keep it coming!
Thanks again.
Jon and Tom
